questions.question: In the Song of Solomon, the young woman speaks one short line about her beloved. What does she say?

answers.text: She belongs to him and his desire is for her
She must wait for him to return
She will search the city for him

questions.question: In the Song of Solomon, the young woman invites her beloved to the countryside to spend the night among the wildflowers. True or false?
In the Song of Solomon, why does the young woman wish her beloved were like a brother to her?

answers.text: So she could kiss him outdoors and not be despised
So they could share the family vineyard together
So they could inherit their father's land together
